# Move Zanzibar

> Community centre in Jambiani, Zanzibar, Tanzania. Runs a free youth training program in acrobatics, dance, and English for local children and teenagers, and puts on a live acrobatics and dance show open to the public every Saturday.

## Key facts
- Location: Jambiani, Zanzibar, Tanzania — a community-led NGO, not a tour operator or business.
- Live show: every Saturday, 4:30–6:00 PM, at the Move Zanzibar Community Centre in Jambiani.
- Founder: Ndimu (Clalence Lutumo), founder, director, and lead mentor. Grew up on mainland Tanzania and began training children on the beach in Jambiani before the centre existed.
- Youth Program: free training in acrobatics, dance, and English for children and teenagers from the local community, plus food and a safe space.
- Community life: the young performers live, train, cook, and manage the centre together.
- Booking: beyond the free Saturday show, Move Zanzibar performs for hotels, events, and festivals across Zanzibar.
- Donations: go by direct bank transfer straight to the account the centre uses for food, training, and upkeep — no platform fee, no middleman.
- Contact: zanzibarmove@gmail.com · +255 718 360 613 (phone / WhatsApp)
- Website: https://www.move-zanzibar.com
